thought.text: Now install dependencies. This is a large monorepo, so I'll run it in the background and monitor.

reasoning_content:
Standard settings. Note that `minimumReleaseAge: 1440` (minutes = 24 hours) is for the registry packages — the lockfile pins exact versions that were released long ago, so it shouldn't be an issue.

Next, run `pnpm install`. This might take a few minutes. The terminal timeout is 600 seconds. For safety, let's run it in the background and poll.

action.command:
cd /workspace && (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile > /tmp/pnpm-install.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?" >> /tmp/pnpm-install.log) &
echo "started bg install, pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile > /tmp/pnpm-install.log 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\" >> /tmp/pnpm-install.log) &\necho \"started bg install, pid $!\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Start pnpm install in background"}
